ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigation into the recent freeze of Medicaid funding in Minnesota, and the entities and individuals involved in the fraud
questions: What is the scope of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and waste in the Medicaid program. By following the money and investigating the entities and individuals involved, we can shed light on the issue and hold those responsible accountable.
